_doc: Monster brain tunables (core/monsters/brains/monster_brain.gd). Tiles and seconds. keep: distance band an archer or caster holds. trigger: how close a lurker or ambusher lets prey come. backoff: seconds of retreat after an attack. speed: move_x scale while chasing. dark_ambush: creatures that wait hidden (Invisible) while lurking in the light field's DARK, seen again reveal_s after they spring (docs/tracks/raids-below.md). burrow: burrowers that dig as they move (core/monsters/burrow.gd): natural tile id ranges they may dig, cap_per_min tiles a minute (per creature), pile: tiles dug per pile of rubble left behind, rate_per_tile_s: hardness-seconds dug per tile a second of burrow speed.
